name: ITT
outlook:
What ITT says to expect

  • Full year 2026: revenue growthBased on strong commercial and operational performance year-to-date, the company now expects organic revenue growth of 7% to 9% and total revenue growth of 41% to 43%.
  • Full year 2026: EPSEPS is expected to be $4.65 to $4.73, with adjusted EPS of $8.54 to $8.62, representing growth of 19% to 20% for the full year.
  • Full year 2026: free cash flowThe company expects free cash flow to be between $600 million and $620 million, translating to a free cash flow margin of ~11% for the full year.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
